verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارࣰ ا

t.khattab: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately
t.pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private

verses.ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا

t.khattab: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving
t.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving

verses.ar: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰ ا

t.khattab: He will shower you with abundant rain
t.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain

verses.ar: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا

t.khattab: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers
t.pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers

verses.ar: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارࣰ ا

t.khattab: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah
t.pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا

t.khattab: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺
t.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages

verses.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا

t.khattab: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
t.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجࣰ ا

t.khattab: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp
t.pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتࣰ ا

t.khattab: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant
t.pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجࣰ ا

t.khattab: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺
t.pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطࣰ ا

t.khattab: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you
t.pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

verses.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلࣰ ا فِجَاجࣰ ا

t.khattab: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”
t.pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof

verses.ar: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا

t.khattab: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss
t.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرࣰ ا كُبَّارࣰ ا

t.khattab: and who have devised a tremendous plot
t.pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot

verses.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدࣰّ ا وَلَا سُوَاعࣰ ا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرࣰ ا

t.khattab: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
t.pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلࣰ ا

t.khattab: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
t.pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error

verses.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارࣰ ا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارࣰ ا

t.khattab: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah
t.pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

t.khattab: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth
t.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرࣰ ا كَفَّارࣰ ا

t.khattab: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers
t.pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا

t.khattab: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
t.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin

verses.ar: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰ ا

t.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation
t.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an

verses.ar: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺
t.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring
t.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطࣰ ا

t.khattab: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah
t.pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا

t.khattab: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah
t.pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقࣰ ا

t.khattab: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness
t.pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺
t.pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا

t.khattab: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
t.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them
t.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
t.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions
t.pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا

t.khattab: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
t.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا

t.khattab: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged
t.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance
t.pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا

t.khattab: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
t.pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell

verses.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا

t.khattab: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
t.pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

verses.ar: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
t.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him
t.pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him
t.pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling

verses.ar: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
t.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner

verses.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا رَشَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
t.pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you

verses.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا

t.khattab: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him
t.pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

verses.ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

t.khattab: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever
t.pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower
t.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude

verses.ar: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا

t.khattab: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it
t.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it

verses.ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

t.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone
t.pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدࣰ ا

t.khattab: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
t.pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

verses.ar: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا

t.khattab: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
t.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things

verses.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ

t.khattab: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺
t.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment

verses.ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ ا

t.khattab: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—
t.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little

verses.ar: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا

t.khattab: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less
t.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

t.khattab: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
t.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan.
